fade_years.why: Margins are above the company's median and the base rate says an above-median margin in a cyclical business closes only part of the gap over 5 to 10 years, so I use a 10-year fade. quotes.quote: Our industry is cyclical and both recessions and prolonged periods of slow economic growth may negatively affect our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.

long_run_op_margin.why: Nucor's history is cyclical, with a median margin near 8.4% and 18-26% in 2021-2023. The base rate says an above-median margin keeps about half its gap, which implies roughly 12%. I take 11% because the 2026 peak leans on tariff support that the 10-K says may not last. Nucor's higher-value products and EAF flexibility support a margin above the old median.
